title: 1Password Service account token (ops_): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: an = inside the body; Base64url padding only ends the value, alphabet: one body byte replaced by +, standard Base64, outside the stated Base64url class, and alphabet: one body byte replaced by /, standard Base64, outside the stated Base64url class. Twin of "1Password Service account token (ops_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of onepassword-service-account-token-actions-env: alphabet: an = inside the body; Base64url padding only ends the value. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
